lead: `cargo test --lib <name>` runs none of a binary crate's unit tests.
body: `nvs-cli`'s cases live in the `nvs` bin target, so a `--lib` filter reports `0 passed` and `136 filtered out` with no hint that the target holding the test was never built. Filter with `cargo test --bins <name>` for anything under `crates/nvs-cli/src/`, and read the `filtered out` count beside the `0 passed` rather than the `ok`.
